text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. Transportation Services is requesting approval to install stop control for westbound traffic at the intersection of Easthampton Drive and Greyswood Court. Based on the assessment undertaken, the installation of stop control for westbound traffic is recommended and should enhance safety for all road users.
The Etobicoke York Community Council: 1. Approved the installation of a compulsory stop control for westbound traffic on Greyswood Court at Easthampton Drive.
